dialect.detail: Likely compiled with GnuCOBOL (formerly OpenCOBOL) on AIX/Linux; uses COMP-X, indexed file with LOCK MODE MANUAL, file paths under /var/fedex/ssp/ on AIX 6.1
evidence: lock mode is manual with lock on record

purpose.domain_detail: FedEx SmartPost internal logistics - reading and displaying records from an OPF (Outbound Package File) delete-record database
purpose.summary: This utility program opens an indexed file of deleted OPF records (dklpWFOpfDelRecs), sequentially reads all records, and displays barcode and deletion date for each. It includes error handling that logs file status errors to an ERRORCOBLOG file.

notable_features: COMP-X for linkage section status field
Indexed file with LOCK MODE MANUAL / WITH LOCK ON RECORD
COPY statement using absolute file path (non-standard)
PROCEDURE DIVISION USING linkage section parameter
STRING statement for error message construction
ACCEPT from TIME and DATE YYYYMMDD
File paths specific to AIX 6.1 directory structure
verdict.notes: Program is property of FedEx SmartPost, written 2007, updated 2012 for AIX 6.1 directory structure change. Uses EXIT PROGRAM suggesting it may be called as a subprogram despite having STOP RUN. The COPY path references /home/oasis/include/ suggesting an 'oasis' system context. Tab characters appear in the file-control section (mixed indentation).
